title: Chapter 210 Ancestral Land Of Xiao Clan
content:
Chapter 210 Ancestral Land Of Xiao Clan

"Second, Elder II, are you not kidding?"

After being stunned for a long time, a man from the Xiao clan said in disbelief.

An immortal king can serve as the savior of their Xiao clan.

What a joke.

Even if their Xiao clan has fallen now, it will not be reduced to the point of seeking a fairy king to save him.

Everyone looked at Xiao Chen and the others together, hoping to get a reasonable explanation.

Seeing this scene, Xiao Xuanmu turned his head directly.

It seems that this time he is not the one who left with Xiao Chen.

Xiao Chen also had a little helpless look on his face.

Turning his head to look at Lu Xue.

"Miss Lu, don't be surprised, my clan,,"

Before he finished speaking, Lu Xue raised his hand and interrupted him.

"I'll save these nonsense. Just tell me what's going on with your clan, right?"

From beginning to end, Lu Xue never took the Xiao clan seriously.

This time I volunteered, mainly because I wanted to open my eyes and see what this fairy world looked like.

Seeing Lu Xue not taking their Xiao clan seriously, the Xiao clan suddenly made everyone feel a little angry.

"Little girl, I don't care who you are. This is the Xiao clan. I advise you to be more low-key and don't think that if you have some skills, you don't know what your surname is."

"That's right, if my Xiao tribe's affairs are so easy to solve, will it be your turn, an outsider?"

"Two elders, I didn't say to you. I know you are anxious, but you can't seek medical treatment indiscriminately."

Everyone pointed at Lu Xue and pointed at Xiao Chen. Every word and I could see it, Xiao Chen's face became increasingly ugly.

"Okay, then I'll go."

Just as Xiao Chen wanted to interrupt, Lu Xue, who was beside him, suddenly said this and then turned around and left.

Seeing Lu Xue leave, Xiao Chen and Xiao Xuanmu were suddenly panicked.

These are the reinforcements who were licking their faces and invited from the deserted city.

Moreover, according to their perception, there are probably not many people in the entire fairy world who can solve their Xiao clan crisis except Huangcheng who may have this strength.

And those people are even more unlikely to help them.

"Miss Lu, wait!"

Xiao Chen quickly stepped forward and stopped Lu Xue who was about to leave.

Seeing this scene, the tribe members behind him looked bad.

"Second Elder, let her go, a little girl wants to help me with Xiao clan. My Xiao clan will not have fallen to this point."

This statement immediately attracted the recognition of the tribe members.

However, the next moment, a crisp slap sounded from the scene.

"You are presumptuous!"

Xiao Xuanmu, who had been silent all the time, suddenly roared.

The clamored clan member covered his hot face and looked at Xiao Xuanmu in disbelief.

"Three, Three Elders, you,"

"Shut up! There is no place for you to speak here!"

Xiao Xuanmu's face was ferocious, and then his eyes glanced at all the tribesmen present, which made the tribesmen feel a little cold.

They haven't seen their elders get angry for a long time.

"Now, our clan is facing the danger of extermination. You are still immersed in the glorious fantasy of the Xiao clan. Reality, can't you recognize the reality!"

"The Third Elder said it well."

At this time, Xiao Chen nodded in agreement.

"Our clan is already in trouble with internal and external troubles. The other three major families are already eyeing our Xiao clan, but the internal crisis of our clan has not been resolved. If we are proud of ourselves, then our clan may really be destroyed. ”

For a moment, all the tribesmen present lowered their heads.

I don’t know if it’s shame or hesitation.

"Miss Lu, please have a chance with my Xiao clan."

Xiao Chen looked at Lu Xue and then bowed heavily.

On the side, Xiao Xuanmu followed closely behind.

Seeing this scene, everyone in the Xiao clan looked at each other, one of them took the lead, and the others followed one after another. In the end, everyone present bent down towards Lu Xue.

"Please give me another chance to the Xiao clan."

Standing at the focus of everyone, Lu Xue had no expression on her face, "Tell me clearly and tell me, and then I will solve it. Is there any problem?"

Hearing this, Xiao Chen shook his head quickly, "No, Miss Lu, please come inside."

Lu Xue nodded slightly, and then followed Xiao Chen and slowly walked into the Xiao clan.

Seeing this, the rest of the people slowly stood up.

"Remember, Miss Lu is a distinguished guest invited by me and you must treat you respectfully."

Xiao Xuanmu said coldly.

"Yes, elder."

Inside the Xiao clan’s meeting hall.

"Miss Lu, what's next is the biggest secret in my Xiao clan. Please don't disclose it."

Xiao Chen sat next to the main seat and said solemnly.

Hearing this, Lu Xue, who was sitting in the main seat, nodded indifferently, "I understand, you can tell me quickly."

Seeing Lu Xue nodding, Xiao Chen sighed and began to tell the story of the Xiao clan.

"My Xiao clan has been established for hundreds of millions of years. It is not an exaggeration to be called the oldest and most powerful force in the fairy world. Since the ancestors of Xiao clan have conquered this rich land, my Xiao clan is strong and prosperous. to date."

Speaking of this, a light shone in Xiao Chen's eyes, as if he had seen the invincible Xiao clan back then.

Although as time goes by, the Xiao clan gradually weakens and is no longer like the past, it is also an existence that no one dares to mess with.

But now.

The Xiao clan is weak, and the strongest person in the clan is only a strong man in the late stage of the Ninth Level of the Immortal Emperor, and his lifespan is not long.

There are four ancient forces in the Immortal Realm, in addition to their Xiao clan, there are also three tribes of Ye, Chu and Xie.

Now that the Xiao clan has low strength, the other three clans are ready to swarm in and divide the Xiao clan at any time.

"Later, what happened to you Xiao clan?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue asked.

Xiao Chen smiled bitterly and continued, "Until tens of millions of years ago, there was an accident in the ancestral land of my Xiao clan, causing a large number of strong men from my Xiao clan to lose contact. Until today, I don't know whether it's death or life."

"Zudi? Lost contact?"

Lu Xue was confused.

Xiao Chen nodded and said, "The ancestral land was left for us by my ancestors of Xiao clan back then. It is the foundation of my Xiao clan and the destination of everyone in my Xiao clan. Every qualified Xiao clan member will be buried after his death. There.”

"Ten millions of years ago, a huge fragment fell into the ancestral land of my Xiao clan from the sky, and since then, the ancestral land of my Xiao clan has changed."

"Anyone who enters the ancestral land, no matter who he is, will eventually lose contact and will never get out."

Xiao Chen's face was covered with sadness.

"Three years ago, the current patriarch of our tribe also entered the ancestral land, and there has been no news until today."

Hearing this, Lu Xue's face became inexplicably solemn.

"Take me to see."

It’s useless to just say it, but I only know after reading it.

Xiao Chen did not refuse and took Lu Xue towards the direction of his ancestral land.

In just a moment, a hazy mountain came into view.

The entire mountain, like a sharp sword, penetrated into the earth, with peaks and ridges, fascinating.

This is the ancestral land of the Xiao clan, also known as the ancestral mountain.

It was originally the capital of the Xiao clan's arrogant one, but now it has become the nightmare for every Xiao clan.
